description: This file declares the FFmpegDemuxer implementation class for FFmpeg integration, including methods for creating, initializing, reading packets, seeking, and configuration parsing, specific to the ffmpeg_demuxer_impl interface.

classes.name: FFmpegDemuxerImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: Template specialization of FFmpegDemuxerImpl for FFMPEG, implementing demuxing functionalities using FFmpeg libraries.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an FFmpegDemuxer instance for a specific FFmpeg version, returning null if unsupported.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the demuxer, setting up necessary FFmpeg contexts.

methods.name: HasAudioStream
methods.description: Checks if the media has an audio stream.

methods.name: HasVideoStream
methods.description: Checks if the media has a video stream.

methods.name: GetDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the media.

methods.name: GetStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the media.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data packets of specified stream type asynchronously.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified timestamp in the media.
